description: This file defines helper functions to create configuration objects for sandbox environments, including browser, prune, and SSH configurations. It imports specific types from the sandbox types module and exports functions that return configuration objects with default values, allowing for overrides.

methods.name: export function createSandboxBrowserConfig( createSandboxBrowserConfig
methods.description: Creates a sandbox browser configuration object with default settings, allowing overrides.

methods.name: export function createSandboxPruneConfig( createSandboxPruneConfig
methods.description: Creates a sandbox prune configuration object with default settings, allowing overrides.

methods.name: export function createSandboxSshConfig( createSandboxSshConfig
methods.description: Creates a sandbox SSH configuration object for a given workspace root, with defaults and overrides.
